ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Dot (3rd Gen, 2018 release) - Smart speaker with Alexa - Charcoal; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Hands-free Alexa control would complement my Fire TV devices and connected-home setup.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Show 5 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- Smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Charcoal; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: A smart display interests me, but I would choose the larger Echo Show 8 this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire HD 10 Tablet (10.1" 1080p full HD display, 64 GB) – Black (2019 Release); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent purchases focus on home viewing and cameras; I have no clear need for a tablet right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Show 8 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- HD smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Sandstone; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The larger display and Alexa controls would be useful additions to my connected-home setup.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick streaming device with Alexa built in, includes Alexa Voice Remote, HD, latest release; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a Fire TV Stick 4K and a Fire TV television, so another HD stick adds little.
ItemID: NA; Title: Amazon Smart Plug, for home automation, Works with Alexa - A Certified for Humans Device; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Adding Alexa control to an existing lamp or appliance is a practical extension of my home setup.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Flex - Plug-in mini smart speaker with Alexa; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Compact voice control fits my interests, but I would try the Echo Dot before adding another Alexa speaker.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Dot (4th Gen) | Smart speaker with clock and Alexa | Twilight Blue; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Alexa fits my setup, but the clock does not give me a clear reason to choose this alongside the other devices.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire 7 tablet, 7" display, 16 GB, (2019 release), Black; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not currently looking for a small tablet; my entertainment purchases center on television viewing.
ItemID: NA; Title: Amazon Fire HD 8 tablet, 8" HD display, 64 GB, (2020 release), designed for portable entertainment, Black; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Portable entertainment is not a clear current need based on how I have been building my home viewing setup.
